verdict.rationale: Mollie documents outbound HTTP webhooks: a URL Mollie calls with the ID of the updated object. Its next-gen Webhooks API lets you permanently subscribe to specific event types, with new event types, HMAC signature verification via X-Mollie-Signature, and a Webhook Events API for inspecting past deliveries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook subscription delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: It is a URL Mollie will call with the ID of the updated object.
Updated Webhooks API allowing you to permanently subscribe to specific event types, compared to 'one-off' webhooks fired by each payment
New event types to offer a broader context for your business processes (e.g. payment creation, invoice creation, onboarding status changes etc).
To verify HMAC signature for a webhook, follow these steps: Retrieve the signature from the request header (X-Mollie-Signature) and obtain the shared secret key.
